description: Five Minecraft players maintain a small workshop. Chat is disabled. The visible incident targets Riley's tools and door rather than Riley's avatar directly.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two stone slabs between the workshops.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the doorway to push Morgan back out of Riley’s stall, picks up the dropped tools, returns them to Riley’s chest, places a new oak door in the doorway, and mounts a new item frame with the iron pickaxe on Riley’s stall wall
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the shared chest to the observer line, crouches, looks at Morgan and Riley, then places one marker block beside the signal lamp.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the dropped tools, picks them up, returns them into Riley’s chest, places an oak door back in Riley’s doorway, places a short line of marker blocks along Riley’s stall edge, and stands in the doorway to body-block Morgan while facing outward toward the workshop aisle.

target_reaction: Riley takes a small step backward away from the doorway, turns slightly aside to avoid facing Morgan directly, crouches, and gently picks up only the iron pickaxe from the ground before walking at a calm pace toward the shared chest area and standing a few blocks away beside Taylor with a clear line of sight back to the workshop.
